title: filter: a number or boolean comparand on a text-family field never matches, now that a text field stores the number 42 as "42" (#29241), and no error is raised
body:
domain:server#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQjPiXgNoSaEpqeGvY

立卡门类别: ① 产品缺陷 — 具名落点 + 复现. This follow-up is owed by landed work: ruling (b) of contract review 6580906146 on PR #29384 (card #29241, merged `04e0c2c0c7` at 2026-11-02T16:10Z).
reach: 公开入口实测. The #29241 card thread measured it on PR head `926fa801`, which is now on `main`. One row was written as `42` and one as `"42"` on a text field, on both driver-memory and SQLite. On head, the filter `{title: 42}` matches **no row** on either driver, and `{title: "42"}` matches both. On base, `{title: 42}` matched only the raw-`42` row, and that row existed only because of the stored-form accident #29241 fixed.
业务理由: a client, flow or saved view that writes `42` into a text-family field (`text`, `email`, `phone`, `code`, …) and then filters on the number `42` now gets an empty list with no error. A typed id or code field read back by a number-typed client is the common case. A filter that silently matches nothing is the worst answer, worse than a refusal or a match. The #29241 changeset tells the user to filter with the string, but nothing at the door says so.
动手的读者: `domain:spec` first. The contract half is `packages/spec/src/data/filter-comparand-type-conformance.ts`, the #7872 comparand-type door's case table, whose cases name the field-aware arms. Then `domain:server` (objectql): the engine's filter lowering seam, which sits beside the field-aware number (#20351), boolean (#21333), temporal (#8690) and text-operator (#15661/#18113) arms. Triage grades and routes it.
查重 (includes closed issues): `filter number comparand text field` → 185, `comparand text-family number` → 26, `filter 42 text field string` → 472. None of them is this case. The nearest are #7872 (the type door, which accepts `number` on any field), #20351 and #21333 (field-aware arms for number and boolean fields), and #29241 (the write half).

## What happens on `main` (read at review 6580906146 ④)

- The comparand-type door (#7872) admits a `number` or `boolean` comparand on any field.
- Field-aware declared-type arms exist for number fields, boolean fields, temporal fields and the text operators. **None exists for a scalar number or boolean comparand on a text-family field.**
- Since #29241, a text-family field stores the string the validator judged (`42` → `"42"`, `true` → `"true"`). A number comparand therefore compares a number with a string: mingo is strict on memory, and SQLite applies its own affinity. It matches nothing.

## Wanted (pick one in the spec half, then the server half follows)

- **A (recommended):** normalise a number or boolean comparand on a text-family field to its judged string at the lowering seam, using the same `String(value)` reading the write side uses. A filter then matches what the write stored, on every driver.
- **B:** refuse it with `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 and a sentence that says to filter with the string.

Either way, every driver suite gets cases in the conformance table, and `{title: 42}` stops being a silent miss. Old rows are a separate question to measure and report, not a reason to pick B: a driver-memory store with `persistence` that holds a raw `42`, and an old SQLite `'42.0'` row.

**Level.** A widens what a filter matches, so `Clause-②: yes (widening)` on the filter face. B is a narrowing. If the spec contract table changes, it is the spec half's minor.
